Experimenting with unproven techniques to make a table. Brought to us by Squarespace. Go to http://squarespace.com/makesomething to save 10% oﬀ your first purchase of a website or domain using code MAKESOMETHING.

Epoxy (Provided by TotalBoat): https://bit.ly/3W0vTJ8
Hardwood from Kencraft: https://goo.gl/pCyB95

I found a vintage atomic-age table in my grandma's attic and fell in love with the shape, so I decided to build my own version from scratch. But instead of my usual colored veneer top, I wanted to try something I'd never done before, an experiment with epoxy resin and fabric that I genuinely wasn't sure would work. What followed was a lot of second-guessing, a few mistakes, and one surprise near the end I didn't see coming.
